reviews.note: bear 表示“忍受”时常用于 cannot bear；动物“熊”是名词。生育义较正式，日常常说 have a baby。

before.meaning: 承受；忍受；生（孩子）；熊
before.example: I can't bear the pain.
before.exampleCn: 我忍受不了这疼痛。

after.meaning: 承受；忍受；生（孩子）；熊
after.example: I cannot bear this noise.

examples.en: I cannot bear this noise.
A bear crossed the road.
She will bear a child in May.

reviews.note: 鞠躬读 /baʊ/；弓和蝴蝶结读 /bəʊ/（美音 /boʊ/）。不要把同形词的读音混用。

before.meaning: 鞠躬；弓
before.example: The actor took a bow after the show.
before.exampleCn: 演员在演出结束后鞠躬致谢。

after.meaning: 鞠躬；弓
after.example: Please bow to the audience.

examples.en: Please bow to the audience.
He carried a bow and arrows.
examples.zh: 他带着一把弓和一些箭。

examples.en: She tied the ribbon in a bow.

reviews.note: box 可指盒子或表格上的方框；作动词时可表示进行拳击运动。

before.meaning: 盒子；箱子
before.example: Please put the gifts in a box.
before.exampleCn: 请把礼物放在盒子里。

after.meaning:
n. 盒子；箱子；方框
v. 进行拳击；装箱
after.example: Please open this small box.

examples.en: Please open this small box.
They box at the sports club.
examples.zh: 他们在体育俱乐部练拳击。

examples.en: Tick the box beside your name.
examples.zh: 在你姓名旁的方框里打勾。

reviews.note: case 可以指情况、案件或箱盒；in this case 常用来承接前文，表示在这种情况下。

before.meaning: 情况；案例；箱子
before.example: In that case, we should leave.
before.exampleCn: 那样的话，我们应该离开。

after.meaning:
情况；案例；箱子
n. 案件
after.example: In this case, we should wait.
after.exampleCn: 在这种情况下，我们应该等一等。

examples.en: In this case, we should wait.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该等一等。

examples.en: Put the camera in its case.
The police are working on this case.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这个案件。

reviews.note: chest 可指人的胸部，也可指一个较大的储物箱；要结合身体或物品语境判断。

before.meaning: 胸部；箱子
before.example: He has pain in his chest.
before.exampleCn: 他胸部疼痛。

after.meaning: 胸部；箱子
after.example: He felt pain in his chest.

examples.en: He felt pain in his chest.
The blankets are in that wooden chest.

reviews.note: close 作关闭义时结尾读 /z/；表示近或亲密时结尾读 /s/。close to 后面可接地点或人。

before.meaning: 关闭；结束
before.example: Please close the door.
before.exampleCn: 请关门。

after.meaning:
v. 关闭；结束（结尾读 /z/）
adj. 近的；亲密的（结尾读 /s/）
adv. 接近地；紧挨着（结尾读 /s/）
after.example: Please close the window.

examples.en: Please close the window.
The school is close to my home.
They are close friends.
Stay close to me.

reviews.note: 社团属于 club 已有的组织义，并非另一个完全缺失的意思；club 还可指高尔夫球杆或棍棒。

before.meaning: 俱乐部
before.example: He joined a chess club.
before.exampleCn: 他加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。

after.meaning: n. 俱乐部；社团；棍棒；高尔夫球杆
after.example: I joined the school chess club.
after.exampleCn: 我加入了学校的国际象棋社团。

examples.en: I joined the school chess club.
examples.zh: 我加入了学校的国际象棋社团。

examples.en: He chose a club for the shot.
examples.zh: 他为这一杆选了一支球杆。

examples.en: His club was made of wood.

reviews.note: coach 不只有教练义；by coach 是乘长途汽车，in coach 可表示在飞机的经济舱中。

before.meaning: 教练/指导，训练
before.example: The coach encouraged the team before the game./She coaches young athletes on weekends.
before.exampleCn: 教练在比赛前鼓励了队员。/她周末训练年轻运动员。

after.meaning:
n. 教练；长途汽车（英式）；车厢；经济舱（美式）
v. 指导；训练
after.example: Our coach is patient with beginners.
after.exampleCn: 我们的教练对初学者很耐心。

examples.en: Our coach is patient with beginners.
examples.zh: 我们的教练对初学者很耐心。

examples.en: She coaches the school team.
We went to the coast by coach.
examples.zh: 我们乘长途汽车去了海边。

examples.en: We flew in coach to save money.
examples.zh: 我们为了省钱坐了经济舱。

reviews.note: 器官、正式机构和管风琴是 organ 的不同名词义；演奏乐器时常用 play the organ。

before.meaning: 器官；机构；风琴
before.example: The heart is a vital organ.
before.exampleCn: 心脏是重要器官。

after.meaning: 器官；机构；风琴
after.example: The heart is an important organ.

examples.en: The heart is an important organ.
The court is an organ of the state.
examples.zh: 法院是国家的一个机构。

examples.en: She plays the organ at church.

reviews.note: hide 作动词时表示藏，过去式 hid、过去分词 hidden；兽皮义是名词。

before.meaning: 隐藏；躲藏；隐瞒
before.example: Hide the money under the bed.
before.exampleCn: 把钱藏在床下。

after.meaning:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；隐瞒
n. 兽皮
after.example: Hide the gift under the bed.

examples.en: Hide the gift under the bed.
The hide is used to make leather.

reviews.note: wound 表示伤口或使受伤时读 /wuːnd/；作为 wind（缠绕）的过去式和过去分词时读 /waʊnd/。

before.meaning: 伤口/使受伤
before.example: The wound healed quickly.
before.exampleCn: 伤口愈合很快。

after.meaning:
n. 伤口（/wuːnd/）
v. 使受伤；伤害（/wuːnd/）
wound 也是 wind（缠绕）的过去式和过去分词，此时读 /waʊnd/。
after.example: The nurse cleaned the wound.

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the wound.
The sharp glass may wound your hand.
examples.zh: 锋利的玻璃可能划伤你的手。

examples.sense: v. 缠绕（wind 的过去式，/waʊnd/）
examples.en: He wound the string around the box.

reviews.note: sole 作形容词强调“唯一的”，常放在名词前；鞋底义是可数名词。

before.meaning: 唯一的/鞋底
before.example: She was the sole winner of the prize./The sole of my shoe is worn out.
before.exampleCn: 她是这项奖的唯一获奖者。/我鞋子的鞋底磨坏了。

after.meaning: 唯一的/鞋底
after.example: She is the sole owner of the shop.
after.exampleCn: 她是这家商店的唯一店主。

examples.en: She is the sole owner of the shop.
examples.zh: 她是这家商店的唯一店主。

examples.en: There is a hole in the sole.

reviews.note: 树皮义通常作不可数名词；狗叫可用动词 bark，或用名词 a bark 表示一声叫。

before.meaning: 树皮/吠叫
before.example: The bark of this tree is very thick./The dog barked loudly at night.
before.exampleCn: 这棵树的树皮很厚。/那只狗晚上大声吠叫。

after.meaning: 树皮/吠叫
after.example: The bark is rough and thick.

examples.en: The bark is rough and thick.
Dogs often bark at strangers.

reviews.note: 名词 object 重音在前；动词重音在后。“反对”常用 object to，to 后接名词或动名词。

before.meaning: 物体；目标/反对
before.example: Some students objected to the new rule.
before.exampleCn: 一些学生反对这项新规定。

after.meaning: 物体；目标/反对
after.example: Please move this heavy object.

examples.en: Please move this heavy object.
Our main object is to save time.
examples.zh: 我们的主要目标是节省时间。

examples.en: I object to this unfair rule.
examples.zh: 我反对这条不公平的规定。

reviews.note: on a large scale 表示大规模地；scale down 表示按比例缩小，不是攀爬。

before.meaning: 规模；刻度/攀登；测量
before.example: The company expanded on a global scale.
before.exampleCn: 公司以全球规模扩张了。

after.meaning:
规模；刻度/攀登；测量
v. 按比例缩放（scale down/up）
after.example: We cannot work on this scale.
after.exampleCn: 我们无法以这种规模开展工作。

examples.en: We cannot work on this scale.
examples.zh: 我们无法以这种规模开展工作。

examples.en: Read the scale on the thermometer.
They tried to scale the wall.
Please scale the picture down.
examples.zh: 请把这张图片按比例缩小。

reviews.note: in stock 表示有现货；stock 作动词可指商店备有某种商品。

before.meaning: 库存；股票/储备
before.example: The store keeps a large stock of fresh fruit.
before.exampleCn: 这家商店储备了大量新鲜水果。

after.meaning: 库存；股票/储备
after.example: The shop has no milk in stock.

examples.en: The shop has no milk in stock.
She bought stock in the company.
examples.zh: 她买了这家公司的股票。

examples.en: This shop stocks fresh fruit.

reviews.note: 下沉是动词义，过去式 sank、过去分词 sunk；厨房里的水槽是可数名词。

before.meaning: 下沉；沉没/水槽
before.example: The boat began to sink in the storm.
before.exampleCn: 这艘船在暴风雨中开始下沉。

after.meaning: 下沉；沉没/水槽
after.example: The boat began to sink.

examples.en: The boat began to sink.
Please wash the cups in the sink.

reviews.note: tie 作动词可接鞋带等物体；领带和平局是两个不同的可数名词义。

before.meaning: 系；连接/领带；平局
before.example: Please tie the package with a strong rope.
before.exampleCn: 请用结实的绳子把包裹系好。

after.meaning: 系；连接/领带；平局
after.example: Please tie your shoes before running.

examples.en: Please tie your shoes before running.
He wore a blue tie.
The game ended in a tie.

reviews.note: a stake in 可以指所持股份，也可以指与某事有关的利益；不要都译成木桩。

before.meaning: 桩/股份/利害关系/用桩支撑
before.example: The company has a large stake in the success of the project.
before.exampleCn: 公司在这个项目的成功中有很大的利害关系。

after.meaning: 桩/股份/利害关系/用桩支撑
after.example: Push the stake into the ground.

examples.en: Push the stake into the ground.
She owns a stake in the company.
examples.zh: 她持有这家公司的股份。

examples.en: They have a stake in its success.
examples.zh: 这件事成功与否关系到他们的利益。

examples.en: He staked the young tree.
examples.zh: 他给那棵小树打桩支撑。

reviews.note: seal 可以指动物海豹，也可以指印章、封条；作动词时常指把开口封好。

before.meaning: 海豹/印章/封条/密封
before.example: The container was sealed to keep the samples clean.
before.exampleCn: 容器被密封起来以保持样本洁净。

after.meaning: 海豹/印章/封条/密封
after.example: The seal swam near the boat.

examples.en: The seal swam near the boat.
The letter bears an official seal.
Do not break the seal.
Please seal the bag tightly.

reviews.note: rear 作形容词通常放在名词前；at the rear 指在后面。饲养或抚养义作动词，较正式。

before.meaning: 后部的/后面/抚养/饲养
before.example: The emergency exit is at the rear of the building.
before.exampleCn: 紧急出口在建筑物的后部。

after.meaning: 后部的/后面/抚养/饲养
after.example: Please use the rear door.

examples.en: Please use the rear door.
The garden is at the rear.
They rear sheep on the farm.

reviews.note: plot 的故事情节、土地和密谋义要按语境区分；plot data 指把数据标在图上。

before.meaning: 情节/小块土地/密谋/绘制
before.example: The graph plots temperature changes over time.
before.exampleCn: 这张图绘制了温度随时间的变化。

after.meaning: 情节/小块土地/密谋/绘制
after.example: The film has a simple plot.
after.exampleCn: 这部电影的情节很简单。

examples.en: The film has a simple plot.
examples.zh: 这部电影的情节很简单。

examples.en: We grow beans on this plot.
examples.zh: 我们在这小块地上种豆子。

examples.en: They plot to escape at night.
We plot the results on a graph.
examples.zh: 我们把结果绘制在图上。

reviews.note: stroke 作名词可指一次动作、笔画或中风；轻抚某人或动物时用动词。

before.meaning: 一击/笔画/中风/轻抚
before.example: A single stroke of the brush changed the painting.
before.exampleCn: 画笔的一笔改变了这幅画。

after.meaning: 一击/笔画/中风/轻抚
after.example: One stroke of the axe split it.
after.exampleCn: 斧子一劈就把它劈开了。

examples.en: One stroke of the axe split it.
examples.zh: 斧子一劈就把它劈开了。

examples.en: Add one stroke to this character.
She had a stroke last year.
Please stroke the cat gently.

reviews.note: shed 的过去式和过去分词仍是 shed；棚屋义是可数名词。

before.meaning: 脱落/流出/棚屋
before.example: Trees shed their leaves in autumn.
before.exampleCn: 树木在秋天落叶。

after.meaning: 脱落/流出/棚屋
after.example: Trees shed their leaves in autumn.

examples.en: Trees shed their leaves in autumn.
We keep bikes in the shed.
examples.zh: 我们把自行车放在棚屋里。

reviews.note: switch to 后接要改用的事物；switch off 是关掉，switch on 是打开。

before.meaning: 转换/开关
before.example: You can switch off the lights before leaving.
before.exampleCn: 离开前你可以关灯。

after.meaning: 转换/开关
after.example: We can switch to another plan.
after.exampleCn: 我们可以改用另一个计划。

examples.en: We can switch to another plan.
examples.zh: 我们可以改用另一个计划。

examples.en: The switch is beside the door.
Please switch off the kitchen light.

reviews.note: grave 作形容词表示严重或严肃，不表示“坟墓的”；坟墓义是可数名词。

before.meaning: 严重的/坟墓
before.example: The scientist warned of grave damage to the ecosystem.
before.exampleCn: 这位科学家警告生态系统会受到严重破坏。

after.meaning: 严重的/坟墓
after.example: This is a grave mistake.

examples.en: This is a grave mistake.
They placed flowers on the grave.
examples.zh: 他们在坟墓上放了鲜花。

reviews.note: trunk 可指树干、躯干、象鼻或汽车后备箱；汽车后备箱义主要用于美式英语，英式常说 boot。

before.meaning: 树干/躯干/行李箱
before.example: The trunk of the tree stores water during dry seasons.
before.exampleCn: 树干在旱季储存水分。

after.meaning:
树干/躯干/行李箱
n. 象鼻；汽车后备箱（美式，英式常说 boot）
after.example: The tree has a thick trunk.

examples.en: The tree has a thick trunk.
Keep your trunk straight during this exercise.
examples.zh: 做这个动作时保持躯干挺直。

examples.en: Put the bags in the trunk.
examples.zh: 把包放进汽车后备箱里。

examples.en: The elephant lifted its trunk.

reviews.note: vessel 是较正式的船只或容器用语；blood vessel 是血管，不是装血的普通器皿。

before.meaning: 船只/容器/血管
before.example: The vessel carried supplies across the ocean.
before.exampleCn: 这艘船把物资运过海洋。

after.meaning: 船只/容器/血管
after.example: This vessel carries food to the island.
after.exampleCn: 这艘船向岛上运送食物。

examples.en: This vessel carries food to the island.
examples.zh: 这艘船向岛上运送食物。

examples.en: Fill the vessel with clean water.
examples.zh: 往容器里装上干净的水。

examples.en: A blood vessel carries blood.

reviews.note: 一排和划船读 /rəʊ/（美音 /roʊ/）；英式“争吵”读 /raʊ/。

before.meaning: 一排/划船
before.example: The students sat in the front row of the classroom.
before.exampleCn: 学生们坐在教室第一排。

after.meaning: 一排/划船
after.example: Please sit in the front row.

examples.en: Please sit in the front row.
We row across the lake.
They had a row after dinner.

reviews.note: pitch 可指音高，也可指英式用语中的球场；pitch an idea 是向别人推介想法。

before.meaning: 音高/球场/投掷/推销
before.example: The singer’s pitch was clear and accurate.
before.exampleCn: 歌手的音高清晰而准确。

after.meaning: 音高/球场/投掷/推销
after.example: The note has a high pitch.

examples.en: The note has a high pitch.
The players ran onto the pitch.
He can pitch the ball fast.
I will pitch my idea tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要推介自己的想法。

reviews.note: on someone's lap 是坐在某人大腿上；跑道的一圈是 a lap；lap up 可指动物舔着喝。

before.meaning: 大腿上部/一圈/舔/轻拍
before.example: The runner completed one lap around the track.
before.exampleCn: 跑者绕跑道完成了一圈。

after.meaning: 大腿上部/一圈/舔/轻拍
after.example: The child sat on her lap.

examples.en: The child sat on her lap.
Run one lap around the track.
The cat will lap up the milk.
Small waves lap against the boat.

reviews.note: be bound to do 表示一定或很可能做某事；bound 也可以是 bind 的过去式和过去分词。界限义常用复数 bounds。

before.meaning: 一定会的/受约束的/跳跃/边界
before.example: The project is bound to succeed with enough support.
before.exampleCn: 有足够支持，这个项目一定会成功。

after.meaning: 一定会的/受约束的/跳跃/边界
after.example: You are bound to make mistakes.

examples.sense: adj. 一定会的（be bound to）
examples.en: You are bound to make mistakes.

examples.sense: v. 捆绑（bind 的过去分词）
examples.en: His hands were bound with rope.
examples.zh: 他的双手被绳子捆住了。

examples.en: The dog will bound across the field.
examples.zh: 那只狗会跳着跑过田野。

examples.sense: n. 界限（常用复数 bounds）
examples.en: Please keep within these bounds.

reviews.note: 水龙头义在英式英语中常用 tap；美式常说 faucet。tap resources 指开发利用资源。

before.meaning: 轻拍/水龙头/开发利用
before.example: Please tap the screen to start the program.
before.exampleCn: 请轻点屏幕来启动程序。

after.meaning: 轻拍/水龙头/开发利用
after.example: Tap the screen to continue.

examples.en: Tap the screen to continue.
Please turn off the tap.
We can tap the sun's energy.

reviews.note: court 可以指法院、球场或宫廷；作动词“追求”时较正式，也可表示争取支持。

before.meaning: 法院/球场/宫廷/追求
before.example: The case was settled in court.
before.exampleCn: 这个案件在法庭上解决了。

after.meaning: 法院/球场/宫廷/追求
after.example: The judge works in this court.
after.exampleCn: 这位法官在这家法院工作。

examples.en: The judge works in this court.
examples.zh: 这位法官在这家法院工作。

examples.en: The tennis court is empty.
She served at the royal court.
He hoped to court her.

reviews.note: 动物鹤与起重机都是名词；crane one's neck 指为了看清而伸长脖子。

before.meaning: 鹤/起重机/伸长脖子看
before.example: A crane lifted the heavy steel beam.
before.exampleCn: 一台起重机吊起了沉重的钢梁。

after.meaning: 鹤/起重机/伸长脖子看
after.example: A crane stood by the lake.

examples.en: A crane stood by the lake.
The crane lifted a heavy box.
examples.zh: 起重机吊起了一个重箱子。

examples.en: She craned her neck to see.

reviews.note: hail a taxi 是招手拦车；hail someone as 表示称赞某人为；hail from 表示来自某地。

before.meaning: 冰雹/欢呼/招呼/来自
before.example: The crops were damaged by hail.
before.exampleCn: 庄稼被冰雹损坏了。

after.meaning: 冰雹/欢呼/招呼/来自
after.example: Hail hit the roof last night.

examples.en: Hail hit the roof last night.
He tried to hail a taxi.
They hail her as a hero.
My grandparents hail from Wales.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母来自威尔士。

reviews.note: jar 作名词指罐子；动词可表示让人不舒服或不安，常与神经、感受等搭配。

before.meaning: 罐子/刺耳地震动/使不快
before.example: The jam was stored in a glass jar.
before.exampleCn: 果酱被装在玻璃罐里。

after.meaning: 罐子/刺耳地震动/使不快
after.example: Put the jam in this jar.
after.exampleCn: 把果酱放进这个罐子里。

examples.en: Put the jam in this jar.
examples.zh: 把果酱放进这个罐子里。

examples.en: The sudden noise jarred my nerves.
examples.zh: 突如其来的噪声让我心神不宁。

reviews.note: 闪电常用 a bolt of lightning；bolt 作动词可指突然冲出去，也可指用门闩闩门。

before.meaning: 螺栓/闪电/猛冲/闩上
before.example: A loose bolt caused the machine to shake loudly.
before.exampleCn: 一颗松动的螺栓导致机器剧烈震动。

after.meaning: 螺栓/闪电/猛冲/闩上
after.example: Please tighten this loose bolt.
after.exampleCn: 请拧紧这颗松动的螺栓。

examples.en: Please tighten this loose bolt.
examples.zh: 请拧紧这颗松动的螺栓。

examples.sense: n. 闪电（a bolt of lightning）
examples.en: A bolt of lightning lit the sky.
The dog may bolt through the gate.
examples.zh: 那只狗可能会冲出大门。

examples.en: Please bolt the back door.

reviews.note: toll 可指通行费；death toll 指死亡人数；take a toll on 表示对某人或某物造成损害。

before.meaning: 伤亡人数/代价/通行费/鸣钟
before.example: The long drought took a heavy toll on local farms.
before.exampleCn: 长期干旱给当地农场造成了沉重代价。

after.meaning: 伤亡人数/代价/通行费/鸣钟
after.example: We paid a toll at the bridge.
after.exampleCn: 我们在桥边交了通行费。

examples.en: We paid a toll at the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们在桥边交了通行费。

examples.en: The death toll rose overnight.
examples.zh: 死亡人数在一夜之间上升了。

examples.sense: n. 代价；损害（take a toll）
examples.en: The hard work took a toll on him.
examples.zh: 繁重的工作损害了他的健康。

examples.en: The bells toll at noon.

reviews.note: plate 的盘子义与地壳板块义不同；地理语境中的 plates 不应译成餐盘。

before.meaning: 板块/盘子
before.example: The Pacific Plate is moving slowly westward.
before.exampleCn: 太平洋板块正缓慢向西移动。

after.meaning: 板块/盘子
after.example: Put the bread on this plate.
after.exampleCn: 把面包放在这个盘子上。

examples.en: Put the bread on this plate.
examples.zh: 把面包放在这个盘子上。

examples.en: The two plates move slowly apart.
examples.zh: 这两个板块正缓慢地分离。

reviews.note: spring 可指春季、泉或弹簧。季节名词通常不用冠词；a spring 可以是一口泉或一个弹簧。

before.meaning: 泉水/春天/弹簧
before.example: The village gets its water from a natural spring.
before.exampleCn: 这个村庄从一处天然泉水中取水。

after.meaning: 泉水/春天/弹簧
after.example: Spring brings warm days.

examples.en: Spring brings warm days.
This spring has clear water.
The spring inside the pen is broken.

reviews.note: pupil 可以指学生，也可以指眼睛的瞳孔；这里的瞳孔不是学生眼中的倒影。

before.meaning: 学生/小学生
before.example: The school has over 1,000 pupils.
before.exampleCn: 这所学校有1000多名学生。

after.meaning: n. 学生；小学生；瞳孔
after.example: Each pupil has a new book.
after.exampleCn: 每个学生都有一本新书。

examples.en: Each pupil has a new book.
examples.zh: 每个学生都有一本新书。

examples.en: The pupil gets smaller in bright light.

reviews.note: 楼层义的 story 是美式拼写，复数 stories；英式通常写 storey，复数 storeys。

before.meaning: 故事/情节
before.example: The story captivated readers around the world.
before.exampleCn: 这个故事吸引了全世界的读者。

after.meaning: n. 故事；情节；新闻报道；楼层（美式，英式拼写 storey）
after.example: She told me a funny story.
after.exampleCn: 她给我讲了一个有趣的故事。

examples.en: She told me a funny story.
examples.zh: 她给我讲了一个有趣的故事。

examples.en: The story appeared in today's newspaper.
examples.zh: 这则报道刊登在今天的报纸上。

examples.en: This house has only one story.

reviews.note: record 作名词时重音在前，作动词时重音在后；唱片和纪录都用名词读音。

before.meaning: 记录/唱片
before.example: The athlete broke the world record.
before.exampleCn: 这位运动员打破了世界纪录。

after.meaning:
记录/唱片
v. 录制；记录
after.example: She set a new record.

examples.en: She set a new record.
This record belonged to my grandfather.
examples.zh: 这张唱片以前属于我的祖父。

examples.en: Please record the lesson.

reviews.note: file 可指文件或锉刀；file into 表示排成一列进入，file papers 表示给文件归档。

before.meaning: 文件/档案
before.example: He saved the document as a PDF file.
before.exampleCn: 他把文件保存为一个PDF文件。

after.meaning:
n. 文件；档案；锉刀；一列人或物
v. 归档；提交文件；排成一列行进；用锉刀锉
after.example: Save the file before closing.

examples.en: Save the file before closing.
Use a file to smooth the edge.
The pupils filed into the hall.
examples.zh: 学生们排着队走进大厅。

examples.en: Please file these letters by date.
examples.zh: 请按日期给这些信件归档。

reviews.note: mean 的动词、名词和形容词义要分开；mean to do 表示打算做某事，mean doing 表示意味着做某事。

before.meaning:
v. 意思是；意味着；意指；打算
n. 平均数；平均值
adj. 吝啬的；刻薄的；平均的
before.example: What does this word mean?
before.exampleCn: 这个词是什么意思？

after.meaning:
v. 意思是；意味着；意指；打算
n. 平均数；平均值
adj. 吝啬的；刻薄的；平均的
after.example: What does this sign mean?

examples.en: What does this sign mean?
The mean of two and four is three.
He was mean to his little sister.
He is mean with money.

reviews.note: table 可以指家具，也可以指按行列排列的表格；表格义常见于 shows、lists 等数据说明中。

before.meaning: 表格/桌子
before.example: The results are presented in the table below.
before.exampleCn: 结果列在下表中。

after.meaning: 表格/桌子
after.example: The keys are on the table.

examples.en: The keys are on the table.
This table shows our test scores.
examples.zh: 这张表列出了我们的考试分数。

reviews.note: temple 可指宗教建筑，也可指头部耳朵上方附近的太阳穴；人体部位常用复数 temples。

before.meaning: 庙宇/寺院
before.example: The ancient temple stands on top of the hill.
before.exampleCn: 古庙矗立在山顶上。

after.meaning: n. 庙宇；寺院；太阳穴
after.example: We visited a temple by the river.
after.exampleCn: 我们参观了河边的一座寺庙。

examples.en: We visited a temple by the river.
examples.zh: 我们参观了河边的一座寺庙。

examples.en: He gently rubbed his temple.

reviews.note: the press 常指新闻界；a university press 是大学出版社；press the button 用的是动词。

before.meaning: 新闻界/出版社
before.example: The press plays an important role in a democracy.
before.exampleCn: 新闻界在民主中扮演着重要角色。

after.meaning:
新闻界/出版社
v. 按；压
after.example: The press reported the news.
after.exampleCn: 新闻界报道了这则消息。

examples.en: The press reported the news.
examples.zh: 新闻界报道了这则消息。

examples.en: She works for a university press.
examples.zh: 她在一家大学出版社工作。

examples.en: Press this button to start.

reviews.note: race 作名词可指比赛，也可指种族或族群；动词可直接与其他参赛者或目的地搭配。

before.meaning:
v. 赛跑；参加竞速比赛；快速移动
n. 赛跑；竞赛；种族；族群
before.example: We race each other across the playground.
before.exampleCn: 我们在操场上互相比赛跑步。

after.meaning:
v. 赛跑；参加竞速比赛；快速移动
n. 赛跑；竞赛；种族；族群
after.example: The race starts after lunch.

examples.en: The race starts after lunch.
We race each other to the gate.
examples.zh: 我们比赛看谁先跑到大门。

examples.en: People of every race are welcome.
examples.zh: 我们欢迎各个族群的人。

reviews.note: trip 作旅行义时通常是可数名词；trip over 后接绊到的东西，不等同于任何失误。

before.meaning: 旅行/出行
before.example: The school trip to Paris was very exciting.
before.exampleCn: 学校的巴黎之旅非常令人兴奋。

after.meaning:
n. 旅行；出行
v. 绊倒；使绊倒（如 trip over）
after.example: Our trip begins on Friday.

examples.en: Our trip begins on Friday.
Do not trip over the bag.

reviews.note: nail 可指钉子或指甲；toenail 是脚趾甲。具体物体要结合钉画或手指的语境判断。

before.meaning: 钉子/指甲
before.example: He hammered a nail into the wall.
before.exampleCn: 他把钉子锤进了墙里。

after.meaning: 钉子/指甲
after.example: Use a nail to hang the picture.
after.exampleCn: 用一颗钉子把画挂起来。

examples.en: Use a nail to hang the picture.
examples.zh: 用一颗钉子把画挂起来。

examples.en: There is paint on my nail.

reviews.note: match 作动词可以直接接所搭配的物品；a match 可能是一根火柴，也可能是一场比赛。

before.meaning:
v. 与……相配；匹配；使配对
n. 火柴；比赛；相配的人或物
before.example: Your shoes match your coat.
before.exampleCn: 你的鞋子和外套很相配。

after.meaning:
v. 与……相配；匹配；使配对
n. 火柴；比赛；相配的人或物
after.example: My shoes match this coat.
after.exampleCn: 我的鞋和这件外套很配。

examples.en: My shoes match this coat.
examples.zh: 我的鞋和这件外套很配。

examples.en: Light the candle with a match.
The match begins at seven.

reviews.note: a fan of 表示某人或某事的爱好者；风扇义与粉丝义不同，fan 也可以作动词扇风。

before.meaning: 风扇/扇子
before.example: The fan kept the room cool on hot days.
before.exampleCn: 风扇在热天里保持着房间的凉爽。

after.meaning:
n. 风扇；扇子；粉丝；爱好者
v. 扇风；扇动
after.example: The fan keeps the room cool.

examples.en: The fan keeps the room cool.
She is a big fan of this band.
examples.zh: 她是这个乐队的忠实粉丝。

examples.en: She fanned her face with a book.

reviews.note: 金属铁通常是不可数名词；熨斗是可数名词，熨衣服时 iron 也可作动词。

before.meaning: 铁/熨斗
before.example: The bridge is made of iron and steel.
before.exampleCn: 这座桥是由铁和钢制成的。

after.meaning:
铁/熨斗
v. 熨烫
after.example: Iron is a useful metal.

examples.en: Iron is a useful metal.
The iron is too hot.
Please iron this shirt.

reviews.note: 金属铅读 /led/；带领和领先读 /liːd/。带领的过去式、过去分词是 led（/led/），不是 lead。

before.meaning: 铅
before.example: Lead pipes were once used in plumbing.
before.exampleCn: 铅管曾一度用于自来水管道。

after.meaning:
n. 铅（读 /led/）；领先地位（读 /liːd/）
v. 带领；领导；导致（读 /liːd/）
after.example: Lead is a heavy metal.

examples.en: Lead is a heavy metal.
Please lead us to the station.
She has a lead of two points.

reviews.note: mine 作代词可单独使用，不在后面再加名词；名词可指矿井或地雷，动词可指开采矿物。

before.meaning: 矿/矿山
before.example: He worked in a coal mine for twenty years.
before.exampleCn: 他在煤矿工作了二十年。

after.meaning:
n. 矿井；矿山；地雷
pron. 我的东西；属于我的人或物
v. 采矿；开采
after.example: It is dark inside the mine.

examples.en: It is dark inside the mine.
This blue coat is mine.
The road was closed because of a mine.
examples.zh: 这条路因发现地雷而封闭了。

examples.en: They mine coal in this area.

reviews.note: 点餐用 order food；排列顺序常用 in order；下订单可以说 place an order。

before.meaning: 点餐/命令/顺序
before.example: Are you ready to order your food?
before.exampleCn: 你准备好点餐了吗？

after.meaning:
点餐/命令/顺序
n. 订单
after.example: I would like to order some soup.

examples.en: I would like to order some soup.
The soldier followed the order.
Put these numbers in order.
examples.zh: 把这些数字按顺序排列。

examples.en: We placed an order for rice.
examples.zh: 我们下了一份大米订单。

reviews.note: crop 可以指作物或收获量；crop a photo 是裁剪照片，不是种照片。

before.meaning: 庄稼/农作物
before.example: Rice is the main crop grown in this region.
before.exampleCn: 水稻是这个地区种植的主要作物。

after.meaning:
n. 庄稼；农作物；收成
v. 修剪；裁剪（如照片）
after.example: Rice is an important crop here.
after.exampleCn: 水稻是这里的重要作物。

examples.en: Rice is an important crop here.
examples.zh: 水稻是这里的重要作物。

examples.en: The farm had a good crop this year.
Please crop the photo before printing.
examples.zh: 打印前请裁剪这张照片。

reviews.note: jam 作果酱义通常不可数；a traffic jam 是一次交通堵塞；动词可指把机器卡住。

before.meaning: 果酱/堵塞
before.example: She spread strawberry jam on her toast.
before.exampleCn: 她在吐司上抹了草莓果酱。

after.meaning: 果酱/堵塞
after.example: I like jam on warm bread.
after.exampleCn: 我喜欢在温热的面包上抹果酱。

examples.en: I like jam on warm bread.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在温热的面包上抹果酱。

examples.en: We were late because of a traffic jam.
examples.zh: 我们因为堵车而迟到了。

examples.en: The paper may jam the printer.
examples.zh: 这张纸可能会卡住打印机。

reviews.note: vault 的金库、拱顶和体操跳马义不同；跳马也可用作动词，表示借助支撑跃过障碍物。

before.meaning: 拱顶/金库/跳马
before.example: The bank keeps the money in a secure vault.
before.exampleCn: 银行把钱存放在安全的金库里。

after.meaning: 拱顶/金库/跳马
after.example: The gold is stored in a vault.

examples.en: The gold is stored in a vault.
The church has a stone vault.
examples.zh: 这座教堂有一个石砌穹顶。

examples.en: She practises the vault every day.

reviews.note: store 作动词可直接接要储存的东西；作可数名词时表示商店，美式英语中很常见。

before.meaning: 储存/商店
before.example: She stored the jam in a cool place.
before.exampleCn: 她把果酱存放在阴凉处。

after.meaning: 储存/商店
after.example: Store the cheese in the fridge.

examples.en: Store the cheese in the fridge.
This store sells fresh bread.

reviews.note: tire 表示轮胎时是美式拼写，英式通常写 tyre；作动词时可指疲劳，tire out 表示使筋疲力尽。

before.meaning: 轮胎
before.example: The car needs a new set of tyres.
before.exampleCn: 这辆车需要一套新轮胎。

after.meaning:
n. 轮胎（美式拼写，英式为 tyre）
v. 使疲劳；感到疲倦
after.example: The front tire is flat.

examples.en: The front tire is flat.
Long walks tire me out.
examples.zh: 长距离步行让我疲惫不堪。

reviews.note: 邮票和印章都是 stamp 的名词义；盖章和跺脚是动词义，要看后面的宾语。

before.meaning: 邮票/印章
before.example: He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
before.exampleCn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。

after.meaning:
邮票/印章
v. 盖章；跺脚
after.example: Put a stamp on the envelope.

examples.en: Put a stamp on the envelope.
Use this stamp on the form.
examples.zh: 在表格上使用这个印章。

examples.en: Please stamp this form.
Do not stamp your feet.

reviews.note: state 作动词表示清楚陈述；名词可指州、国家或状态，不能只按一个中文义理解。

before.meaning: 陈述/国家/州
before.example: He stated his opinion clearly at the meeting.
before.exampleCn: 他在会上清楚地陈述了自己的意见。

after.meaning:
陈述/国家/州
n. 状态；状况
after.example: Please state your name.

examples.en: Please state your name.
Texas is a large state.
The house is in a poor state.
These states share a border.

reviews.note: deal with 后接要处理的人或事情；发牌用 deal the cards。动词过去式和过去分词是 dealt。

before.meaning: 交易/协议/处理
before.example: They signed a deal worth millions of dollars.
before.exampleCn: 他们签署了一笔价值数百万美元的交易。

after.meaning:
交易/协议/处理
v. 发牌
after.example: They agreed to a fair deal.
after.exampleCn: 他们达成了一项公平的协议。

examples.en: They agreed to a fair deal.
examples.zh: 他们达成了一项公平的协议。

examples.en: We must deal with this problem.
examples.zh: 我们必须处理这个问题。

examples.en: Please deal the cards.

reviews.note: sentence 作名词可指句子或刑罚；动词常用 sentence someone to，后接刑罚。

before.meaning: 判决/句子
before.example: He received a prison sentence of ten years.
before.exampleCn: 他被判十年监禁。

after.meaning: 判决/句子
after.example: Write one sentence about your family.
after.exampleCn: 写一句关于你家人的话。

examples.en: Write one sentence about your family.
examples.zh: 写一句关于你家人的话。

examples.en: He received a short prison sentence.
examples.zh: 他被判了一段较短的监禁刑期。

examples.en: The judge sentenced him to prison.

reviews.note: fine 不只有“好的”；罚款可以用名词 a fine，也可以用动词 fine someone for something。

before.meaning: 罚款/好的/精细的
before.example: He had to pay a fine for parking illegally.
before.exampleCn: 他因违章停车不得不缴纳罚款。

after.meaning:
罚款/好的/精细的
v. 处以罚款
after.example: She feels fine today.

examples.en: She feels fine today.
He paid a fine for parking there.
examples.zh: 他因在那里停车而交了罚款。

examples.en: Use a brush with a fine tip.
examples.zh: 用一支笔尖很细的画笔。

examples.en: They fined him for speeding.
examples.zh: 他们因他超速而罚了款。

reviews.note: matter 作名词可指事情或物质；作动词表示重要，常见 it matters 和 it does not matter。

before.meaning: 事情/物质/要紧
before.example: What is the matter with your car?
before.exampleCn: 你的车出了什么问题？

after.meaning: 事情/物质/要紧
after.example: This is a private matter.

examples.en: This is a private matter.
Matter can be solid, liquid, or gas.
examples.zh: 物质可以呈固态、液态或气态。

examples.en: Your opinion matters to me.

reviews.note: mind 表示介意时，后面常接名词、动名词或 if 从句；Mind the steps 是提醒别人注意台阶。

before.meaning: 头脑/思想/介意
before.example: She had a sharp mind even in old age.
before.exampleCn: 她年事已高仍头脑敏锐。

after.meaning:
头脑/思想/介意
v. 留心；注意
after.example: You have a curious mind.

examples.en: You have a curious mind.
Do you mind if I sit here?
Mind the steps.

reviews.note: shoulder 作动词可直接接 responsibility、burden 等宾语，表示承担责任或负担。

before.meaning: 肩膀/肩部
before.example: She carried the heavy bag on her shoulder.
before.exampleCn: 她扛着沉重的包。

after.meaning:
n. 肩膀；肩部
v. 承担（责任、负担等）
after.example: My bag hangs from one shoulder.
after.exampleCn: 我的包挂在一侧肩膀上。

examples.en: My bag hangs from one shoulder.
examples.zh: 我的包挂在一侧肩膀上。

examples.en: She will shoulder the responsibility.

reviews.note: palm 既可指手掌，也可指棕榈树；手心常用 in the palm of one's hand 表达。

before.meaning: 手掌/掌心/棕榈树
before.example: She held the coin tightly in her palm.
before.exampleCn: 她把硬币紧紧握在掌心。

after.meaning: 手掌/掌心/棕榈树
after.example: Hold the coin in your palm.

examples.en: Hold the coin in your palm.
A tall palm grows near the beach.
examples.zh: 海滩附近长着一棵高大的棕榈树。

reviews.note: will 作情态动词时后接动词原形；a strong will 是坚强的意志；in a will 可指在遗嘱中。

before.meaning:
n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱
vi. 下决心, 愿意
aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
before.example: Where there's a will there's a way.
before.exampleCn: 有志者事竟成。

after.meaning:
n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱
vi. 下决心, 愿意
aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
after.example: I will call you tomorrow.

examples.en: I will call you tomorrow.
She has a strong will.
He left the house to me in his will.
examples.zh: 他在遗嘱里把房子留给了我。

reviews.note: like 表示喜欢时作动词；look like 中的 like 表示像。would like 语气较委婉，不是一般现在时的“喜欢”。

before.meaning:
v. 喜欢；想要（常用 would like）
prep. 像；如同；例如
adj. 相似的；同样的
n. 喜好；同样的人或物
adv. 大约（非正式）；可能（方言用法）
before.example: I like reading before bed.
before.exampleCn: 我喜欢在睡前阅读。

after.meaning:
v. 喜欢；想要（常用 would like）
prep. 像；如同；例如
adj. 相似的；同样的
n. 喜好；同样的人或物
adv. 大约（非正式）；可能（方言用法）
after.example: I like these songs.

examples.en: I like these songs.
This cloud looks like a rabbit.
examples.zh: 这朵云看起来像一只兔子。

examples.en: I would like some water.

examples.sense: n. 喜好（常用复数 likes）
examples.en: Tell me your likes and dislikes.
examples.zh: 告诉我你的喜好和厌恶。

reviews.note: well 修饰动作时常作副词；表示身体好时可作形容词；井义是可数名词。

before.meaning:
n. 井, 泉水, 源泉, 好
v. 涌出
a. 健康的, 良好的, 适宜的, 恰当的
adv. 很好地, 适当地, 好意地, 很, 完全
interj. 好啦
before.example: She was a well of information.
before.exampleCn: 她是个消息灵通的人。

after.meaning:
n. 井, 泉水, 源泉, 好
v. 涌出
a. 健康的, 良好的, 适宜的, 恰当的
adv. 很好地, 适当地, 好意地, 很, 完全
interj. 好啦
after.example: She reads very well.

examples.en: She reads very well.
I feel well again.
The well is full of water.
Well, what do you think?

reviews.note: still 可表示仍然，也可描述静止；a still 是一张剧照。句首 Still 还能表示尽管如此。

before.meaning:
n. 蒸馏室, 寂静, 剧照
v. 蒸馏, (使)平静, (使)静止
a. 静止的, 不动的, 静寂的, 不起泡的, 静物摄影的
adv. 仍然, 更, 静止地
conj. 然而, 但是
before.example: Please sit still for a moment.
before.exampleCn: 请坐着别动一会儿。

after.meaning:
n. 蒸馏室, 寂静, 剧照
v. 蒸馏, (使)平静, (使)静止
a. 静止的, 不动的, 静寂的, 不起泡的, 静物摄影的
adv. 仍然, 更, 静止地
conj. 然而, 但是
after.example: He is still at school.

examples.en: He is still at school.
Keep the camera still.
This is a still from the film.
examples.zh: 这是那部电影的一张剧照。

examples.en: Still, we decided to try.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，我们还是决定试一试。

reviews.note: a school of fish 表示一群鱼，与学校义不同；school 作动词时可表示训练或教育。

before.meaning: n. 学校, 鱼群, 门派, 学派\nvt. 教育, 训练, 培养\nvi. 成群地游
before.example: The school was founded in 1900.
before.exampleCn: 学校始建于1900年。

after.meaning: n. 学校, 鱼群, 门派, 学派\nvt. 教育, 训练, 培养\nvi. 成群地游
after.example: The school is near my home.

examples.en: The school is near my home.
A school of fish swam past.
She schooled herself to stay calm.

reviews.note: set 的过去式和过去分词仍是 set。a set of 后接一组物品；太阳落山和液体凝固也可用动词 set。

before.meaning:
n. 日落, 同伙, 组合, 集合, 装置
vt. 放, 安置, 放置, 设定, 使凝结, 点燃, 确定, 点缀, 使就位, 树立, 分配, 调整
vi. 日落, 凝固, 定型, 搁住, 结果, 适合
a. 决心的, 规定的, 故意的
before.example: A set of books.
before.exampleCn: 一套书。

after.meaning:
n. 一套；一组；集合；装置
v. 放；安置；设定；确定；使就位；日落；凝固
adj. 固定的；规定的；准备好的
after.example: This set of cups is new.

examples.en: This set of cups is new.
Set the bag by the door.
Please set the alarm for six.
The sun will set soon.
The jelly will set in the fridge.

reviews.note: long 可以描述长度，也可以表示时间久；动词 long 常用 long to do 或 long for something。

before.meaning:
a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的
vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
adv. 长久, 始终
n. 长时间, 长信号, 长整型
[计] 长, 长整型
before.example: This road is long.
before.exampleCn: 这条路很长。

after.meaning:
a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的
vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
adv. 长久, 始终
n. 长时间, 长信号, 长整型
[计] 长, 长整型
after.example: This bridge is very long.

examples.en: This bridge is very long.
Have you been waiting long?
I long to see my family.

reviews.note: a lot of 后面可接可数或不可数名词；draw lots 表示抽签，不是画许多东西。

before.meaning: n. 运气, 签, 抽签, 份额, 许多, 一堆\nvt. 划分\nvi. 抽签, 抓阄
before.example: A lot of money.
